headline: Quinshon Judkins scores twice. This recap owes Tara an apology.
dek: Marlee posts the league high, Amie wins by 42.46, and the curse on Maddie's quarterbacks finds a new host.

matchups.2-7: Samantha started the best lineup her roster could possibly field and lost by 42.46. The fantasy gods reviewed the tape and found no errors, only Jaxon Smith-Njigba.
matchups.3-4: Tara kept starting Quinshon Judkins through weeks of this recap telling her not to. He paid her back this week, and Weeks 1 and 3 are hereby retracted. Maddie deserved better from her quarterback; more on that below.
matchups.1-8: Marlee posted the league's high score and beat Cambri by 12.58. A week after Amon-Ra St. Brown scored zero on her bench, her team's namesake was back in the lineup, earning the name.
matchups.5-6: Kyra missed her own projection by 26 points and won anyway, the fantasy equivalent of showing up to work in pajamas and getting promoted. Maya had the league's low score; more on that in the flags.

game_balls.title: Ground and air, both covered
game_balls.text: Javonte Williams handled the ground, Amon-Ra St. Brown handled the air, and the Vikings D/ST handled the quarterback. League high score.

game_balls.title: The refund
game_balls.text: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught nine passes for 150 yards and a touchdown. In Week 2 he had an even bigger day for Amie and she lost anyway. Consider this one the refund.

game_balls.title: Tight end, loose definition
game_balls.text: Trey McBride caught ten passes and a touchdown, which is a lot of receiving for a position that's supposed to spend half its day blocking.

flags.title: Benched the answer
flags.text: Cambri started Derrick Henry, who scored 5.9. Tony Pollard scored three touchdowns on her bench. One swap and she wins. She started Henry.

flags.title: One (1) catch
flags.text: Maya benched Luther Burden III for Jalen Coker. Burden went for 130 yards and a touchdown. Coker caught one pass. It was a very nice pass.

tough_breaks.title: Clean sheet
tough_breaks.text: Zero points left on her bench and nothing to fix. That's what a well-managed week looks like, even when the scoreboard disagrees.

tough_breaks.title: The curse has a third victim
tough_breaks.text: Bryce Young threw two interceptions and lost a fumble. He joins Jaxson Dart and Tyler Shough in the haunted wing reserved for Maddie's quarterbacks.

glossary.definition: A roster spot for a player hurt badly enough to need real recovery time. He sits there without counting against your bench limit, but he also can't score you a single point, just ask whoever is parking Travis Etienne Jr. there this week.
When a quarterback gets tackled before he can throw the ball. Bad for his stat line, great for whoever owns the defense that did it. The Vikings D/ST notched four of them for Marlee this week.
A pass caught by the other team's defense instead of yours, which costs the quarterback two points. Bryce Young threw two of them on his way to a 5.42-point week.

A kick through the uprights, worth more the farther out it comes from. Brandon Aubrey made three of them for Cambri this week, including one from way downtown, worth 11 points on their own; three extra points pushed his night to 14.
